name: single_value
description: A text-based widget that displays the current value of any metric type including numeric, text, boolean, date/time, and images. Offers full control over alignment, fonts, colors, thresholds, date formatting, precision, and text truncation.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric to display. Supports all metric types including numeric, text, boolean, date/time, and resource

config.name: vertical_align
config.label: Vertical align
config.description: Positions the content vertically within the widget

config.name: horizontal_align
config.label: Horizontal Align
config.description: Positions the content horizontally within the widget

config.name: alignment
config.label: Alignment
config.description: Controls whether the label appears above or below the value

config.name: gap
config.label: Gap
config.description: The spacing in pixels between the label and value

config.name: space_between
config.label: Space Between label and value
config.description: Pushes the label and value to opposite ends of the widget

config.name: hide_label
config.label: Hide label
config.description: Hides the label text entirely, showing only the value

config.name: label
config.label: Label
config.description: Custom text to display as the label. If not set, the metric name is used

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: The font family for the label text

config.name: font_color
config.label: Font Color
config.description: The text color of the label

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size of the label text in pixels

config.name: precision
config.label: Precision
config.description: The number of decimal places to display for numeric values

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: Override the maximum value used for threshold percentage calculations

config.name: value_font
config.label: Font
config.description: The font family for the value text

config.name: value_font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size of the value text in pixels

config.name: small_unit
config.label: Small Unit
config.description: Renders the unit in a smaller font size next to the value

config.name: hide_unit
config.label: Hide Unit
config.description: Hides the unit suffix from the displayed value

config.name: value_font_color
config.label: Font Color
config.description: The default text color of the value

config.name: warning_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of max value at which the value text switches to the warning color

config.name: warning_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The value text color when the warning threshold is exceeded

config.name: critical_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of max value at which the value text switches to the critical color

config.name: critical_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The value text color when the critical threshold is exceeded

config.name: time_format
config.label: Time Format
config.description: Choose between 12-hour and 24-hour clock format for date/time metrics

config.name: hide_time
config.label: Hide Time
config.description: Hides the time portion of date/time metrics

config.name: hide_seconds
config.label: Hide Seconds
config.description: Hides seconds from the time display, showing only hours and minutes

config.name: date_format
config.label: Date Format
config.description: The order of day, month, and year in the date display

config.name: hide_date
config.label: Hide Date
config.description: Hides the date portion of date/time metrics, showing only the time

config.name: date_separator
config.label: Separator
config.description: The character used to separate day, month, and year in the date display

config.name: truncation
config.label: Truncation
config.description: How to handle text that overflows the widget. None shows full text, Ellipsis adds '...' at the end, Running creates a scrolling marquee effect
